title: Blood Slayer Cao Zhen
summary: Cao Zhen kills the beaten Elder Hua Gu and takes his Mental Strength, then turns on Lin Dong. Mu Lei explains to Mu Qianqian that Cao Zhen, the Blood Slayer, once wiped out a whole sect by himself. Lin Dong fights the Half-step Manifestation elder with the Subduing Golden Platform Magic Palm, the Demon Ape Transformation and Yuan Essence Power. He is nearly crushed until he shows Mental Energy Fire and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger; Cao Zhen survives, but Little Flame grabs Teng Lei and they escape. Under threat of a memory search, Teng Lei reveals that his father will break the treasure's seal in Yin Puppet City in ten days, and that the sect has three Manifestation experts. Lin Dong also takes Teng Lei's Purple Shadow Nine Breaks. Teng Sha keeps his son's capture quiet, while Mu Lei gathers his Qi Creation experts and heads for Yin Puppet City.
events: Cao Zhen kills Hua Gu and takes his Mental Strength.
Mu Lei tells Mu Qianqian about Cao Zhen, the Blood Slayer.
Lin Dong fights Cao Zhen with the Golden Platform palm, the Demon Ape Transformation and Yuan Essence Power, but falls behind.
He turns the fight with Mental Energy Fire and the Great Desolate Heaven-Imprisoning Finger.
Lin Dong and Little Flame carry Teng Lei off while the wounded Cao Zhen watches.
Teng Lei tells him the treasure is in Yin Puppet City, the seal will be broken in ten days, and the sect has three Manifestation experts; Lin Dong takes the Purple Shadow Nine Breaks.
Teng Sha orders silence and more guards; Mu Lei suspects something big and sets out for Yin Puppet City.
cultivation: Cao Zhen is Half-step Manifestation; Lin Dong is Qi Creation. The Yin Puppet Sect has three Manifestation experts, including Teng Sha.
